notes:
XTrace 0.1.8 adds a Scores page and a new name.

- Scores: grade a project with a skill's rubric. Grading runs Claude Code in the background with your Claude account, inside its sandbox: the project stays read-only and the network is off.
- Add a skill: choose from your installed skills, add one from a public GitHub link, or have Claude make a rubric for a skill.
- Effort card: a new "human + agent" tab shows your time each day and how many agents ran in each 15 minutes.
- The app is now called XTrace. After this update, an app named XTrace Desktop renames itself to XTrace the next time you quit it.
- Clearer index status in the sidebar and Settings, and a note when sessions are hidden while XTrace checks which session started them.
- Removed the Typing speed card and the unused Environment report.
